title: Drain Myth: Chemical Cleaners Cure All
description: Many property owners reach for harsh chemical drain cleaners at the first sign of a slow drain, believing it is a universal fix. However, chemical drain cleaners often fail to clear heavy blockages, especially grease or root intrusions, and can sit stagnant in the pipe, severely corroding metal lines and damaging rubber seals. Furthermore, if the chemical fails and a plumber has to manually snake or hydro-jet the line, standing caustic chemicals pose a severe chemical burn hazard. Professional drainage troubleshooting begins with a visual inspection or camera scope to identify the actual root cause of the slowdown before selecting the appropriate mechanical tool.

Drain Myth: Chemical Cleaners Cure All

Many property owners reach for harsh chemical drain cleaners at the first sign of a slow drain, believing it is a universal fix. However, chemical drain cleaners often fail to clear heavy blockages, especially grease or root intrusions, and can sit stagnant in the pipe, severely corroding metal lines and damaging rubber seals. Furthermore, if the chemical fails and a plumber has to manually snake or hydro-jet the line, standing caustic chemicals pose a severe chemical burn hazard. Professional drainage troubleshooting begins with a visual inspection or camera scope to identify the actual root cause of the slowdown before selecting the appropriate mechanical tool.
